title: What a cut-off Sync to live already created is recorded before the next merge, so nothing is duplicated
steps: Run the record-cut case on a push root holding a cut, a finished and a recorded push.
expect: The cut push's created records join the id map and its seeds join pushed.json.
Finished and recorded pushes are left alone; a second run records nothing; more journal lines are recorded again.

tests: a push cut off before it recorded its writes is recorded from its journal before the next merge (#173)
